description: Which schools were added to, changed in, removed from or returned to MEXT's list of institutions eligible for the tuition support system since a date (this service's own record of list versions; MEXT keeps none), and which confirmation revocations and notifications did MEXT publish since then (MEXT's dates, still listed by MEXT)? Free window: last 30 days. Published facts only, not an assessment.

change_type.description: Optional filter: added, modified, removed_from_list, reappeared, revocation_published, noncompliance_notice_published

prefecture.description: Optional filter: prefecture name, JIS code or local government code

school_type.description: Optional filter: university (大学), junior_college (短期大学), college_of_technology (高等専門学校), specialized_training_college (専門学校)

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

name: tuition_support_changes

changes.description: Changes observed by this service between list versions, oldest first.

history_window.description: Free history window applied to this answer.

clamped.description: true when requested_since was earlier than the free window and the answer covers only the window.

free_days.description: Days of recorded history served free of charge.

older_history.description: Status of recorded history older than the free window.

requested_since.description: The since you asked for (normalized to ISO 8601).

served_since.description: The since actually applied: requested_since, or the start of the free window if requested_since was earlier.

official_check.description: Read first: listed as published by MEXT on the date shown; eligibility for an individual student depends on the student's own requirements; confirm with the school and MEXT.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

publications.description: Revocations and notifications MEXT published on or after 'since' and still lists.

effective_on.description: Effective date stated in a revocation publication.

source.description: Where the answer comes from: MEXT page and file, the list's own as-of date, and when this service last fetched it.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

tracking_since.description: When this service first loaded the list. List changes before it were not observed.

title: Tuition support eligible list changes and publications
